Details:
First is here today for complaint of illness. He has been sick since Tuesday night with cough and
runny nose. No fever. No sick contacts. Not too wheezy at this point. He is using an inhaler.
Only coughing up a little sputum. He is not short of breath. He has some body aches. No diarrhea.
His psa last month 0.05 with dr hashmi.
